do_if.value: this.ship.sector == player.sector or this.ship.attention ge attention.visible or not player.entity.$vgo_objects.{this.ship}.$vgo_simfallback

not $sector.exists or $sector == player.sector or not player.entity.$vgo_objects.{this.ship}.$vgo_scope.indexof.{$sector} or (player.entity.$vgo_objects.{this.ship}.$vgo_risk != 2 and $sector.owner.hasrelation.enemy.{faction.player})

$foundsector.exists and player.entity.$vgo_objects.{this.ship}.$vgo_scope.indexof.{$foundsector} and $foundsector != player.sector and (player.entity.$vgo_objects.{this.ship}.$vgo_risk == 2 or not $foundsector.owner.hasrelation.enemy.{faction.player})

set_value.name: player.entity.$vgo_objects.{this.ship}.$vgo_status
set_value.exact: 'Crystal miner: no permitted off-screen ore/silicon field here; seeking another sector'

set_value.name: player.entity.$vgo_objects.{this.ship}.$vgo_status
set_value.exact: 'Crystal miner: travelling to off-screen asteroid field in ' + $sector.knownname

set_value.name: player.entity.$vgo_objects.{this.ship}.$vgo_status
set_value.exact: 'Crystal miner: resource field was not reached; trying a different route'

do_if.value: not this.ship.isplayerowned or this.ship == player.occupiedship or this.ship.order.id != 'VGO_crystal' or this.ship.order != this.ship.defaultorder

this.ship.sector != $sector or $sector == player.sector or this.ship.attention ge attention.visible or this.ship.distanceto.[$sector,$pos] gt 15km + this.ship.size / 2 or (player.entity.$vgo_objects.{this.ship}.$vgo_risk != 2 and $sector.owner.hasrelation.enemy.{faction.player}) or not player.entity.$vgo_objects.{this.ship}.$vgo_scope.indexof.{$sector}

set_value.name: player.entity.$vgo_objects.{this.ship}.$vgo_status
set_value.exact: 'Simulated crystal mining in ' + $sector.knownname + ': ' + ((player.entity.$vgo_objects.{this.ship}.$vgo_crystal_work_elapsed / 1s)i) + '/' + ((player.entity.$vgo_objects.{this.ship}.$vgo_crystal_work_goal / 1s)i) + ' seconds; resource-backed batch, not physical deposits'

do_if.value: not this.ship.isplayerowned or this.ship.order.id != 'VGO_crystal' or this.ship.order != this.ship.defaultorder or this.ship.sector != $sector or $sector == player.sector or this.ship.attention ge attention.visible or (player.entity.$vgo_objects.{this.ship}.$vgo_risk != 2 and $sector.owner.hasrelation.enemy.{faction.player}) or not player.entity.$vgo_objects.{this.ship}.$vgo_scope.indexof.{$sector} or this.ship.distanceto.[$sector,$pos] gt 15km + this.ship.size / 2

set_value.name: $crystalware
set_value.exact: if $roll le 850 then ware.inv_crystal_01 else (if $roll le 970 then ware.inv_crystal_02 else (if $roll le 995 then ware.inv_crystal_03 else (if $roll le 999 then ware.inv_crystal_04 else ware.inv_crystal_05)))

set_value.name: player.entity.$vgo_objects.{this.ship}.$vgo_status
set_value.exact: 'Simulated crystal batch ready: ' + $items + ' items from ' + $drained + ' units of ' + $ore.name + '; seeking station sale'

set_value.name: player.entity.$vgo_objects.{this.ship}.$vgo_status
set_value.exact: 'Crystal resource field depleted; no sale stock credited, seeking another field'

debug_text.text: 'GO crystal simulation: %1 sector=%2 drained=%3 stock_added=%4 active_seconds=%5; no player inventory credit'.[this.ship.debugname,$sector.knownname,$drained,$items,player.entity.$vgo_objects.{this.ship}.$vgo_crystal_work_elapsed / 1s]
